prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1454; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while your insured was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address that contact.

Please provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, dash camera footage, and any communications with the insured or third parties.

Our client's injuries and damages are still being evaluated, and we will provide a full demand once that assessment is complete. Until then, we request that no settlement offers or releases be sent to our client without first notifying this office.
